task:
A fund holds 4020 credits. Its first grant is 15% of that original balance. Return 45% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 3% of the original balance minus 3 credits (the 3 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 5 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 15 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 4 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 4 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 24 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 7 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 16 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 26 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 18 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 12 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
